limitation: 请求文本用于标注典型意图；测试执行对应的流程/工具断言，不是让在线模型逐条理解请求。通过率不能当作模型语义准确率或生产端到端成功率。

cases.request: continue taskT-a881c3557b99
cases.expected: 识别续办编号，不能新建无关任务。

cases.request: could you use the result of T-3897576d5898 to do the adjustment?
cases.expected: Use the settled reference to answer the active question while retaining current task identity and requiring fresh approval.

cases.request: according to the check result change the moodle file sequence
cases.expected: Automatically inject prior check result in the same requester/chat, without requiring a task code.

cases.request: 已有部分操作完成，请继续剩余部分
cases.expected: 跳过已有核验回执的操作，保持剩余依赖顺序。

cases.request: 把 L4 和 L5 移到 Week 5，保留隐藏状态
cases.expected: 按批准顺序移动，保留原 ID 和设置，不误判前一步造成的变化。

cases.request: Move a shown file into a hidden week
cases.expected: Ask about visibility before offering or executing the move.

cases.request: The move succeeded but the visibility options changed
cases.expected: Do not reuse the numeric value; retain position and ask for a visibility outcome without replay.

cases.request: 移动描述里包含图片的活动
cases.expected: 草稿 URL 变化但图片字节相同，不误报设置变化。

cases.request: 按 syllabus 改时间，保留原来的间隔
cases.expected: 从原设置测量时间差，不编造固定间隔。

cases.request: 把提交开放和截止时间设成同一刻
cases.expected: 无效时间窗口在保存前被拒绝。

cases.request: 检查相关设置后再修改
cases.expected: 缺少已知表单时先补读，不能声称已经检查。

cases.request: 模型提交了不存在或重复的字段
cases.expected: 返回精确字段反馈，不执行臆造字段。

cases.request: 发送按钮点过但响应超时
cases.expected: 先读回核验，不重复点击发送。

cases.request: 从 files 替换课程文件
cases.expected: 保留活动 ID、名称、可见性，并核验上传字节。

cases.request: 上传文件，但尚未批准
cases.expected: 不能上传草稿或保存。

cases.request: 审批后 files 中的源文件被更改
cases.expected: 检测源文件变化，停止上传。

cases.request: agent 还活着但任务几十分钟没进展
cases.expected: 心跳不重置任务进展时间，显示进展缓慢。

cases.request: change all the topic x to week x，点击保存被遮挡并超时
cases.expected: 零点击事件和零写请求可证实未派发，允许只读检查，不进入无限等待响应。

cases.request: 点击已发出但 POST 延迟，继续等待保存
cases.expected: 即使暂时没有 POST，也不得重放；原提交完成后只读验证。

cases.request: 修复旧版零 POST 的章节改名阻塞
cases.expected: 只允许显式停用精确标记的旧编辑页，再独立读取完整原状态；不能直接重发保存。

cases.request: after you move the files please let them invisible
cases.expected: 受阻时接收原请求人的修复指令，保留同一任务和完成回执，先规划审批，不直接保存。

cases.request: Save timed out while Moodle background requests were running
cases.expected: Known read RPCs cannot turn proven zero-click into an unresolved save; unknown RPCs remain protected.

cases.request: 另一位群成员要求修复正在执行的任务
cases.expected: 不能接管其他请求人的任务或复用旧审批。

cases.request: 原提交尚未返回，现在继续修复
cases.expected: 保持只读等待，不标记成功，不循环触发修复或重复写入。

cases.request: 移动隐藏文件，保持隐藏
cases.expected: 若 Moodle 移动副作用改变可见性，在同一有效批准下恢复一次并完整读回。

cases.request: 已经移动到目标位置，仅修复可见性
cases.expected: 规划校验拒绝重复移动，续办时保留该约束。

cases.request: Place Storyboard in Week 6 from a Week 5 syllabus row
cases.expected: Reject before writing; row week must equal destination week

cases.request: Resume an expired one-section prerequisite of a 44-item task
cases.expected: Retain all 44 parent items, including after prerequisite completion

cases.request: Finish the approved batch while some source mappings are unresolved
cases.expected: Keep the overall goal incomplete and queue fresh planning

cases.request: Review a correct move from current Week 6 to proposed Week 5
cases.expected: Give the reviewer separate observed-before and proposed-after labels plus source cells; omit current section controls
